data.name: Badiil
data.gender_notes: Badiil is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'badala', meaning 'to replace'. In Islamic context, Badiil signifies the one who brings happiness, joy, and good news. It is also mentioned in the Quran in the context of the Day of Judgment where Allah SWT says, 'So those who believe and do righteous deeds will have the best of it on the earth and in the Hereafter. And We will surely save them from the great affliction.', [Quran 10:62].
data.etymology: Badiil belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Glad tidings, happiness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Badiil total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: بادعيل
in_arabic.long_meaning: بادعيل هو اسم علم عربي يعني الطيب المطيب الرائع، ويُشير إلى الشخص الذي يتميز بجمال الشخصية والخلق، ويُعتبر اسمًا مشتقًا من الجذر الب-د-ع-ل، والذي يرمز إلى الفضل والجمال، وهو اسم يُستخدم في القرآن الكريم في سورة يس: 21، وفي الإسلام يُعتبر اسمًا صالحًا ويُفضل على اسماء أخرى، ويُستخدم أيضًا في بعض الأسماء العائلية في الوطن العربي

in_urdu.name: بادعیل
in_urdu.meaning: بہترین و بڑی محبت کا نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: بادعیل نام بہترین اور بڑی محبت کا نام ہے، اس کے بارے میں کہا جاتا ہے کہ یہ نام جلیل و عظیم شخصیت والا نام ہے، جو انساں کو بہترین اور بڑی محبت کا نام دیتا ہے، اس نام کی اہمیت کو دیکھتے ہوئے اس کے بارے میں کہا جاتا ہے کہ یہ نام مشرق وسطیٰ میں بہت مقبول ہے، اور اس کے علاوہ سارے ممالک کے مسلمانوں میں بھی یہ نام بہت مقبول ہے

in_english.name: Badiil
in_english.meaning: the good, the beautiful, the unique, and the lovely
in_english.long_meaning: The name Badiil is derived from the Arabic root b-d-`-l, which means the good, the beautiful, the unique, and the lovely. It is a name that is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Yasin, verse 21. In Islamic tradition, it is considered a good name and is preferred over other names. It is also used as a surname in some Arab countries. The name Badiil is considered to be a name that is associated with good qualities such as kindness, generosity, and beauty. It is also associated with the idea of uniqueness and individuality. In modern times, the name Badiil is used in many Muslim countries and is considered to be a popular name among Muslims.
